title: 3D U-Net
paper_title: 3D U-Net: Learning Dense Volumetric Segmentation from Sparse Annotation
core_mech: 把 U-Net 的卷积、池化、上采样和 long skip 全部扩展为原生 3D，并支持稀疏切片监督。
core_mech_en: Extends all U-Net convolutions, pooling, upsampling, and long skips to native 3D tensors with support for sparse slice annotations.
input_desc: 3D CT/MRI 子体积或完整体数据
input_en: 3D CT/MRI sub-volume or whole volumetric scan

source.title: 3D U-Net
notes: Author site supplies the 3D Caffe patch, network definitions with/without batch normalization, solver parameters and example weights. CPU supported; original release is not a modern PyTorch implementation.

adapter.name: 3D U-Net
adapter.mechanism: Volumetric convolution/pooling/upsampling and same-scale 3D encoder skips with BatchNorm.
limitations: Random initialization and synthetic data; no original benchmark result or pretrained capability is reproduced.
Reduced channels; same-padding; densely labelled phantoms do not reproduce the sparse-annotation study.

verification.title: 3D U-Net
verification.budget_enforcement: cooperative boundary checks; not an OS allocation limit
limitations: Random initialization and synthetic data; no original benchmark result or pretrained capability is reproduced.
Reduced channels; same-padding; densely labelled phantoms do not reproduce the sparse-annotation study.
verification.isolation: One fresh Python process per model; sequential execution
verification.evidence_note: Original successful execution retained at its original version and date. Executable code and this dataset match the captured release; source registry metadata changed. No model was rerun by this build.

gaps: Original method has no implemented and tested local CPU adapter.
